https://keralarealestate.com/details-675.descriptionText:
A rare and highly valuable 6.75-acre patta land with a licensed helipad is available for sale in Thekkady, Idukki, Kerala. Located approximately 6.8 km from Thekkady and Periyar Tiger Reserve and around 5 km from Kumily Town, this property offers an exceptional opportunity for hospitality, plantation tourism, resort development, and investment.
The property includes a licensed helipad with a contract with Chipsan Aviation, providing a unique advantage for premium tourism and hospitality projects. The helipad can potentially be upgraded to a heliport, subject to the required permissions and regulations.
The property is strategically positioned close to several established premium hospitality properties, including Club Mahindra, Spice Village, Hills and Hews, Elephant Court and Mountain Courtyard, within approximately 5 km.
Visitors can access a wide range of popular activities and attractions around Thekkady, including:
With its combination of large-scale plantation land, licensed helipad, existing campsite, road access, tourism potential, scenic views and resort development possibilities, this property offers a distinctive opportunity for investors and hospitality developers looking to establish a premium plantation resort, wellness retreat, luxury villa project or high-end tourism destination in Thekkady.
₹20 Crore

https://keralarealestate.com/details-lan.listingTitle: Land with House for Sale in Rajakkad, Munnar, Idukki
https://keralarealestate.com/details-lan.descriptionText:
Spread across 5.5 acres, this spacious property combines agricultural land, a residential house, highway frontage and abundant natural water resources.
The property is cultivated with cardamom, pepper, nutmeg and coconut, offering both agricultural and investment potential. A small stream flows through the property, complemented by two large ponds and a well, providing an excellent natural water source.
The property also includes a 4-bedroom house, making it suitable for a family residence, agricultural estate, homestay, resort or other tourism-related development, subject to applicable permissions.
₹75 Lakhs per Acre

https://keralarealestate.com/details-1-b.listingTitle: 1 BHK Apartment for Sale in Thaikkad, Guruvayur, Thrissur
https://keralarealestate.com/details-1-b.descriptionText:
An excellent opportunity to own a 1 BHK apartment in a prime location at Thaikkad Junction, Guruvayur, Thrissur. Located directly along the Guruvayur–Thrissur Highway, this property offers excellent connectivity and is situated just 1.5 km from Guruvayur.
The apartment has a built-up area of 762 sq. ft. and is located on the second floor of a four-storey building. It features one bedroom, two bathrooms and a balcony, providing comfortable accommodation for residents and visitors.
The property is situated in a high-demand area with easy access to clinics, medical shops, restaurants, shopping centres and public transportation facilities. Its strategic location close to Guruvayur makes it an attractive option for both end-users and investors.
Currently, the apartment is being successfully operated as a daily rental property and is listed on popular online accommodation platforms such as Booking.com and Airbnb. The property has the potential to generate good rental income, making it a suitable investment opportunity in the growing Guruvayur tourism and hospitality market.

https://keralarealestate.com/details-12-.descriptionText:
12 Acres Premium Waterfront Land for Sale in Muthukulam, Alappuzha
This is 12 acres of prime waterfront land in Muthukulam North, Alappuzha—one of Kerala’s most sought-after destinations for tourism and water-based developments. This expansive property offers approximately 250 meters of direct frontage along the scenic Kayamkulam Kayal, part of the National Waterway, making it ideal for high-value investment projects.
Strategically located near NTPC, the property enjoys excellent accessibility via a well-connected panchayat road linking Chakklikadavu and Choolatheruvu. The combination of road access and extensive water frontage enhances its potential for a wide range of developments, particularly in the hospitality and tourism sectors.
With its tranquil surroundings, uninterrupted water views and strong connectivity, this land is perfectly suited for boutique resorts, luxury retreats, eco-tourism ventures, houseboat hubs, or other water-oriented commercial projects. The serene backwater setting offers a unique blend of natural beauty and investment potential.
This competitively priced property is available at Rs 1,30,000 per cent, presenting a rare chance to secure a large waterfront parcel in a rapidly growing region.

listingInfo.parking: shaded parking for more than 3 vehicles

amenities: Common toilet for drivers and servants
https://keralarealestate.com/details-a-4.descriptionText:
A spacious 4 BHK independent house for sale in Kadamkode, Palakkad, offering a comfortable and convenient lifestyle in a highly accessible residential location. The property is set on 11.5 cents of land with a generous 2,750 sq. ft. built-up area, making it suitable for families looking for a ready-to-move-in home with ample outdoor space.
The house features 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, providing sufficient privacy and comfort for a large family. The property has its own well with continuous water supply, ensuring a reliable source of water for everyday household requirements.
One of the major advantages of this property is its excellent road connectivity. The house is located just 50 meters from the National Highway, providing easy access to Palakkad and other major destinations. Palakkad Medical College is only around 250 meters away, making this an especially convenient location for families who prefer to have a major healthcare facility nearby.
The Palakkad Railway Station is approximately 4 km away, further enhancing the property's connectivity. The location also offers convenient access to essential amenities, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, shops, and transportation facilities.
The property includes shaded car parking with space for more than three vehicles, making it ideal for families with multiple cars or guests.

https://keralarealestate.com/details-pri.descriptionText:
Prime Corner Plot for Sale in Koottupaatha, Palakkad
This is a premium residential plot in the fast-developing area of Koottupaatha, Palakkad. Strategically located just 1 km from Koottupaatha and 3 km from Palakkad Stadium Bus Stand, this property offers both convenience and long-term value.
Situated in Marudha Road Panchayath, the plot is a desirable corner property with road access on two sides (east and north), each facing 4-meter-wide roads. Its proximity to Palakkad Polytechnic College (located just opposite the road) adds to its appeal, making it ideal for residential development or investment purposes.
The total area is 8.5 cents, with the option to split into two plots of 4.25 cents each, making it suitable for individual buyers or joint investment.

https://keralarealestate.com/details-26-.listingTitle: 26 Cents of Prime Land with Building  for Sale in Vakkom, Trivandrum
https://keralarealestate.com/details-26-.descriptionText:
An excellent opportunity to own a prime 26-cent property with an approximately 1,800 sq. ft. building in Vakkom, Thiruvananthapuram. Located close to the scenic Ponnumthuruth Island and Panayil Kadavu Tourist Village, this property offers excellent potential for tourism, hospitality, wellness and commercial ventures.
The property is situated just 50 metres from the Vakkom S.N. Junction–Panayil Kadavu Road and enjoys valuable main road frontage. Its strategic location, easy accessibility and proximity to popular tourist destinations and important institutions make it a promising investment opportunity.
The spacious compound has a pleasant and green environment with mature mango, coconut and jackfruit trees. The natural surroundings and ample open space make the property particularly suitable for developing a resort, boutique hotel, homestay, Ayurveda centre, wellness retreat or other tourism-related projects.
The existing building of approximately 1,800 sq. ft. can also be utilised or further developed according to the requirements of the buyer. With its prime location and road frontage, the property also offers potential for commercial establishments, institutional purposes or residential development.
This is a beautiful property in a developing tourism-oriented location, combining excellent accessibility, main road frontage and a peaceful natural environment. Its proximity to Ponnumthuruth Island and Panayil Kadavu Tourist Village adds further value for buyers looking to invest in hospitality, tourism or wellness-related projects.
Asking Price: ₹1.25 Crore
